verifiable-quality-gates.why: the whole PR makes a CI gate provably do its job: the parity gate must actually detect a tampered runner, which it could not when run THROUGH that runner (#120); pinned by generated-workflow assertions AND a behavioral harness check that a no-op runner is caught by the direct parity invocation but passes through the runner
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added GENESIS ISSUE-120/125 yml assertions + a #120 behavioral step in the vendored-consumer harness; full suite 737 pass, 0 fail, 3 skipped
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: changing how the generated workflow invokes the self-verifying gates (directly vs through the runner) and where the upstream fetch runs is architecturally significant and recorded in one ADR
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0079 covering both fixes and the honest limit (the workflow file itself remains presence-checked, so branch protection on it is the ultimate backstop)
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: pinned at two levels: a unit assertion on the generated workflow text, and an integration/behavioral check in a real vendored consumer that a no-op runner is caught directly but passes through the runner
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: yml-content tests + a behavioral no-op-runner step in the vendored-consumer harness
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the non-happy paths were enumerated and committed: a tampered (no-op) runner, and a transient upstream fetch error on a non-provenance job
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: node:test cases asserting the workflow runs parity/provenance directly + gates the fetch, and the behavioral no-op-runner catch
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: ADR-0079 states the honest limit rather than overclaiming: this does not close the separate route of editing the presence-checked workflow file itself; branch protection/CODEOWNERS on the workflow remains the ultimate backstop
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the limit in ADR-0079 and verified the suite green before claiming the fix
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the workflow-template delta before the PR, checking the case logic, the fetch gating, and that the existing workflow-content assertions still hold
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent and recorded it in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the #120 CI-integrity hardening (a gate cannot be hollowed by a tampered runner) is a supply-chain/CI concern covered here by verifiable-quality-gates + a behavioral harness check, not a product input/auth/crypto surface that would take an @security Gherkin scenario; no such surface changed

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; the fix edits the generated workflow template's run step and fetch step

arch-encode.why: the fix is enforced by discrimination tests, not a new rules-file entry

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration, backup or audit logic; this is CI workflow generation

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed; it is a CI workflow template

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism; this hardens the PR gate workflow, not a release/deploy path

sre-operational-readiness.why: no production SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or operability surface; #125 improves CI-signal reliability (a transient fetch error no longer reds the required check), which is CI robustness, not production SRE

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; CI tooling

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser or frontend code; CI tooling

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; CI tooling
